reviews.review:
[h1] Best Enjoyed with Friends [/h1]
this game is online co-op for a reason, and that reason is that a singular man is not an army. you may bring the thunder, you may make giant bugs and frog soldiers cower in fear, but who will be there to support you? it sure as ♥♥♥♥ won't be the NPC army, so [strike]harass[/strike] get a friend or acquaintance to play this with you. i can guarantee you will have a good time bonding over killing hordes of giant aliens. onto my actual review.

[b]are the graphics picturesque and beautiful?[/b] no, because that would fry your console/pc. the maps are huge and there are often hundreds of enemies on the field and whether or not you can see the pores on your character's face doesn't matter much when you don't ever see them without a helmet anyways. 

[b]how are the movement mechanics?[/b] pretty great! so far i've only played wingdiver, so i can't comment much on the other classes, but their movement tech is a straight improvement from 4.1 with the added ability to sprint/boost yourself in any direction. 

[b]how is the combat?[/b] you have a wealth of weapons to choose from within each class and will only get more as the game progresses. the game does a fantastic job at balancing the power of your weapons at your disposal and your human squishiness compared to your enemies. [strike](even if it seems a little unfair at times)[/strike]

[b]what of the plot?[/b] lol, what plot? in all seriousness, there is little to no serious plot to get super invested in, and that's on purpose! you're here to fight an invading alien army, not build deep emotional bonds! and of the plot that exists, it is schlocky self-aware alien invasion sci-fi. if i had to tie a theme to this game, it would be how resilient humanity is in the face of impending doom.

[h3]Closing Thoughts[/h3]
this is a very long game with a little over 100 missions that can vary in length, so take breaks when you need to and don't burn yourself out. farming and grinding for upgraded or better weapons is viable but don't sweat it too much if you don't want to, just pick up all the weapon crates you can as you go and you should be fine. now get out there and kill those aliens!!!
I faintly remember playing edf on ps2

Definitely inspired Helldivers 2, but for cheap. it's also been in the market for decades. Really fun and addictive. There's some mechanical depth in the weapons like your playing a Monster Hunter game but it could just be a laid back fun game. It's also really better than EDF 4.1. Air raider class is pure bliss, just to add.
It's a bird! It's a plane! IT'S FLYING ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ BAT FROGS!
